title: Development and validation of a nomogram model for lung cancer based on radiomics artificial intelligence score and clinical blood test data
summary: The combined model reported AUC 0.907 in development and 0.844 in external validation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: The First Clinical Medical School of Lanzhou University; The First Hospital of Lanzhou University

evidence.tested: The combined model reported AUC 0.907 in development and 0.844 in external validation.
evidence.unknown: The source-checked evidence does not establish broader external validity or prospective benefit. Affiliation was not available in the retrieved trusted primary metadata.
evidence.ai_role: ML feature selection generated an AI/radiomics score combined with clinical blood-test variables in a lung-cancer nomogram.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
